name: pepsi-short
description: The Pepsi Jet: a 56 s vertical cartoon short (2D characters in a 3D toon world, three.js inside Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts PepsiShort out/video_silent.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --scale 1.3333 --muted --gl=angle
scripts.render:nocaptions: remotion render src/index.ts PepsiShort out/video_silent_nocaptions.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --scale 1.3333 --muted --gl=angle --props=props/nocaptions.json
scripts.make: npm run sync && npm run render && npm run mux && npm run check
